description: The relief piece table: every placed piece of the cliff with its four facts (footprint, extent, overlap margin, foot line), read by the bake (southruns.mjs, cliffrules.mjs), the walking mask, the decor rules and the proving place. A new kind of piece is a new row. Cells are 48 px; the lip row L is the southmost raised row of a south run; footprints and anchors are in cells relative to the piece's own cell at row L. The rim is not a piece: it is the cliff layer's dual-grid over sheet (over-cliff.png). A south face blocks the lip row and the faceRows rock rows under it (rows L to L+3); the first walkable row is the foot, L+faceRows+1.

propExtents.description: The cells under a standing thing's painted extent, in cells from its trunk or foot: no cell of it may be a ring, face, flank or way-up cell (relief.mjs). A family that is not listed has the extent of its own cell.

pieces.places: P2: under every south lip cell L, rows L + 1 .. L + 3 (crest row, mid row, dark base row), one of three plain columns by world position; cut from the Ninja Adventure relief wall strip (CC0), not yet signed
P3: the west cap on the first cell of a south run, the east cap on its last (a way-up's cut is no run end); the wall strip's rounded, outlined end columns, not yet signed

P4: the one-row cast shade at row L + 4 under every face cell (a two-row dither of the grass's darkest ramp step, tapered under the caps), drawn before the face of its line; blocks nothing (the foot row walks); a palette shade, not yet signed

the Rupar's earth bank (an ir.banks site: two cells wide, the lip row and three face rows): an undug bank has no piece (it draws as today's rock face, the dither patch at the foot and the page's brackets); wayup-dug (a rough cut ramp with a notch in the rim and spoil at the foot, 96 x 192 game px, 32 x 64 art px, alpha) is added by the page when the bank is dug, on the site's west column and top row at the foot line of its lip row plus 3, after the columns of its line; PixelLab inpaint of the bank's own crop (wayup-paint-5), not yet signed

two cells wide, six rows walked (L-2 to L+3; the cut through the 3 rock rows, and the landing row L+4 below it walks as the foot does) on a south run with one plain column each side; the old unsigned way-up tiles stand until it is painted. cliff-way-up-u (the way up U, 213 x 348 game px, placed with its top-left 93 px left of the area and 126 px above its lip row; the paint's own edge, alpha only; stand-in, not signed) is drawn at the foot line of the area's lip row plus 3, after the columns of its line
